beats.text: This area in the Persian Gulf was quiet through the previous day.
At 16:00 UTC the previous day, the system committed a public forecast: 95% jamming probability for 04:00 UTC — 12 hours ahead.
04:00 UTC arrived: GNSS integrity degraded exactly here. Verified hit — called 12 hours in advance, provably committed before the event.

Interference appeared here without a high-risk flag. It stays on the record — misses are published, never hidden.
